verification_report.summary: The proof is correct. It establishes that the empty squares are exactly a monotone E,S path and that each legal move replaces an ES corner by an SE corner. Conversely, adjacent SE-to-ES swaps reduce any path word to the initial word, and reversing the associated northwest slides gives a sequence of legal southeast moves reaching the target configuration. Distinct path words have distinct square sets, so counting the words gives the stated binomial coefficient. The boundary cases are handled correctly. No external references or internal fact IDs are cited, and no hard prohibition is violated.
